ko.title: COP31 개최 2주 전: 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열리는 UN 기후 변화 회의의 관전 포인트

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: 약 200개국 대표단이 연례 유엔 기후 변화 회의인 COP31에 참석하기 위해 튀르키예 지중해 연안의 안탈리아에 모일 준비를 하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: 회담은 11월 중순으로 예정되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: 모든 정상회의는 전환점이 될 것이라고 홍보되지만, 대부분은 타협으로 끝납니다.

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: 따라서 유용한 질문은 COP31이 "기후를 구할 것인가"가 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: 정부, 기업, 투자자가 실제로 하는 행동을 바꿀 수 있는 구체적인 결정이 무엇인지가 중요합니다.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 주요 쟁점, 난관, 그리고 주목할 만한 결과에 대해 다룹니다.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: 의제 세부 사항은 여전히 변경될 수 있으므로, 공식 유엔 기후 변화(UNFCCC) 업데이트를 통해 최신 일정을 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## COP31이 중요한 이유

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: 2015년 파리 협정은 지구 온난화를 산업화 이전 수준보다 2°C 훨씬 낮게 유지하고, 1.5°C로 제한하기 위한 노력을 추구하는 목표를 설정했습니다.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: 몇 년마다 각국은 국가 온실가스 감축 목표(NDC)라고 알려진 업데이트된 국가 기후 계획을 제출하도록 요청받습니다.

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: 각 COP는 그러한 계획과 그 이면의 자금이 어떻게 진행되고 있는지 확인하는 점검 지점입니다.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: COP31은 독특한 구조로도 주목받고 있습니다.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: 튀르키예가 개최국이지만, 두 입찰자 간의 타협에 따라 호주가 협상을 주도하는 역할을 맡았습니다.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: 관찰자들은 이러한 공동 운영 방식이 실제로 어떻게 작동할지, 그리고 가장 즉각적인 기후 위험에 직면한 태평양 섬나라들이 이 과정에서 얼마나 큰 영향력을 발휘할지 지켜볼 것입니다.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. 배출량 감축 공약: 격차가 줄어들고 있는가?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: 모든 COP의 핵심 긴장 요소는 각국이 약속한 것과 과학자들이 필요하다고 말하는 것 사이의 격차입니다.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: 최근 유엔 평가에 따르면 현재의 공약이 완전히 이행되더라도 전 세계는 1.5°C 목표를 훨씬 상회할 것이며, 온도 제한은 적어도 일시적으로는 초과될 것으로 널리 예상됩니다.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 관전 포인트:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **어떤 국가가 업데이트된 계획을 제출했으며, 그 야심은 어느 정도인가.** 일부 주요 배출국은 늦게 제출했거나 분석가들이 보기에 미미한 목표를 제시했습니다.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **계획이 경제 전반과 모든 온실가스를 포괄하는가.** 더 광범위한 목표일수록 추적하고 책임을 묻기가 더 쉽습니다.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **미흡한 목표를 재검토하기 위한 절차.** 가장 의미 있는 결과는 단순한 우려 표명이 아니라, 다음 라운드 전에 각국이 계획을 강화하도록 장려하는 메커니즘일 것입니다.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. 기후 금융: 누가, 얼마나 지불하는가?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: 돈은 보통 가장 어려운 주제입니다.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: 개발도상국들은 역사적으로 배출량이 많았던 부유한 국가들이 배출량을 줄이고 기후 변화의 영향에 적응하기 위한 자금을 제공해야 한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: 공여국들은 예산 부족을 지적하며 민간 자본과 신흥 경제국들도 기여해야 한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: 주요 갈등 지점:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **기존 약속의 이행.** 2024년 바쿠 정상회의에서 각국은 모든 재원을 합쳐 연간 1.3조 달러를 동원하려는 더 큰 야망 내에서 2035년까지 최소 연간 3,000억 달러를 지원한다는 새로운 목표에 합의했습니다. 많은 개발도상국은 이것이 불충분하다고 비판했습니다. 공약이 어떻게 추적될지, 제때 이행될지에 대한 논쟁을 예상하십시오.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **적응 기금.** 홍수, 폭염, 가뭄, 해수면 상승에 대처하는 지역사회를 돕기 위한 자금은 배출량 감축을 위한 자금보다 뒤처져 있습니다. 협상가들은 더 명확한 목표와 일정을 찾을 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **손실과 피해.** 취약한 국가들이 기후 재난으로부터 회복하도록 돕는 기금이 이전 정상회의에서 만들어졌습니다. 이제 문제는 기금 규모가 얼마인지, 얼마나 빨리 지급되는지, 누가 자격이 있는지입니다.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **보조금 대 대출.** 개발도상국들은 대출 형태로 제공되는 금융이 부채 부담을 가중시킬 수 있다고 반복해서 경고해 왔습니다. 보조금과 대출의 혼합은 조용하지만 중요한 세부 사항입니다.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. 미국의 역할

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: 미국은 세계 최대의 역사적 배출국이자 주요 기후 금융 공급원입니다.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: 국제 기후 협력에 대한 미국의 입장은 파리 협정 공식 탈퇴를 포함하여 현 행정부 하에서 눈에 띄게 바뀌었습니다.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: 이는 몇 가지 실질적인 질문을 제기합니다:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **재정 격차.** 미국이 공적 자금을 덜 기여한다면, 다른 국가나 민간 투자자가 그 부족분을 채울 수 있을까요?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **외교적 영향력.** 미국의 입지가 줄어들면 유럽연합(EU), 중국, 대규모 개발도상국을 포함한 다른 강대국들이 결과를 형성할 여지가 생길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **워싱턴을 넘어선 행동.** 미국의 주 정부, 도시, 기업들은 자체적인 기후 노력을 계속할 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 안탈리아에서 이 그룹들이 얼마나 눈에 띄는지, 그리고 그들의 약속이 구체적이고 측정 가능한지 지켜보십시오.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: 합리적인 사람들도 최고의 기후 정책과 특정 국가의 올바른 역할에 대해서는 의견이 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: 독자들에게 중요한 것은 변화하는 미국의 입장이 금융 및 야심 찬 목표에 대한 합의 도달 가능성에 어떤 영향을 미치느냐입니다.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. 화석 연료와 에너지 전환

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: 최근 정상회의에서 각국은 에너지 시스템에서 화석 연료로부터 멀어지는 데 원칙적으로 합의했지만, 그 언어를 구체적인 조치로 바꾸는 것은 논쟁의 여지가 있었습니다.

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: 생산국과 소비국은 시기, 공정성, 천연가스의 역할에 대해 의견이 다릅니다.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: 주목할 점:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **로드맵 또는 일정.** 구속력 있는 날짜가 없더라도 협상가들이 전환 계획을 위한 절차에 합의하는지 여부.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **재생 에너지 및 효율성 목표.** 이전 공약은 2030년까지 재생 에너지 용량을 3배로 늘리고 효율성 개선 속도를 2배로 높일 것을 요구했습니다. 진행 상황 보고서를 통해 세계가 올바른 궤도에 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **노동자와 지역사회 지원.** "정의로운 전환"에는 석탄, 석유, 가스에 의존하는 지역에 대한 재교육과 경제적 지원이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. 의제의 기타 항목

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **탄소 시장.** 국가와 기업 간의 배출권 거래 규칙은 계속 개선되고 있습니다. 품질과 투명성이 주요 관심사입니다.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **적응 진행 상황 추적.** 각국은 지역사회가 기후 영향에 얼마나 잘 대비하고 있는지 측정하기 위한 지표를 개발하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **산림, 메탄 및 기타 부문별 이니셔티브.** 이들은 종종 부대 행사에서 발표되며 실질적인 감축을 가져올 수 있지만, 일반적으로 자발적입니다.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## 진정한 결과로 간주될 수 있는 것

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: 정상회의 공동성명은 거창하게 들릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 지표는 실질적인 내용과 상징적인 것을 구분하는 데 도움이 됩니다:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **의도뿐만 아니라 숫자와 날짜.** 구체적인 금융 금액, 전달 일정 및 보고 요건.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **책임성.** 약속이 지켜졌는지 확인할 수 있는 명확한 방법.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **주요 배출국들의 새롭거나 강화된 국가 계획**, 특히 전 세계 배출량의 가장 큰 비중을 차지하는 국가들.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **현장에 도달하는 자금.** 필요한 국가와 지역사회가 접근할 수 있는 자금.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **신뢰할 수 있는 후속 조치.** 다음 COP 이전에 행동을 취하기 위한 절차를 포함하는 결정.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: 반대로 모호한 언어, 연기된 결정, 자금 지원이 없는 공약은 제한된 진전의 징후입니다.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## 팔로우하는 방법

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - 공식 업데이트와 일일 요약은 유엔 기후 변화(UN Climate Change)에서 게시합니다.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - 연구 기관에서 운영하는 것과 같은 독립적인 추적 기관들이 국가 공약과 금융 흐름을 평가합니다.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - 신뢰할 수 있는 뉴스 조직들이 현장 보도와 분석을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: 여러 출처를 비교하고 초기 헤드라인은 주의해서 다루십시오.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: 최종 텍스트의 세부 사항이 초기 발표보다 더 중요한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: COP31이 모든 분쟁을 해결할 가능성은 낮지만, 각국이 약속과 행동 사이의 격차를 어떻게 좁힐 의도인지, 누가 비용을 지불할 것인지, 그리고 변화하는 정치 상황 속에서 국제 협력이 유지될 수 있을지를 명확히 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: 금융 수치, 국가 계획의 강도, 화석 연료에 대한 언어를 주시하십시오.

zh.title: COP31 还有两周：土耳其安塔利亚联合国气候大会看点解析

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: 来自近 200 个国家的代表正准备齐聚土耳其地中海沿岸的安塔利亚，参加联合国年度气候会议 COP31。

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: 谈判定于 11 月中旬举行。

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: 每届峰会都被宣传为转折点，但大多数最终都以妥协告终。

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: 因此，有价值的问题不是 COP31 是否会“拯救气候”。

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: 而是哪些具体决定能够改变政府、企业和投资者的实际行动。

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: 本指南涵盖了主要议题、分歧点以及值得关注的成果。

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: 议程细节仍可能发生变化，因此请查看联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）的官方更新以获取最新日程。

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么 COP31 至关重要

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: 2015 年《巴黎协定》设定了一个目标，即把全球平均气温较工业化前水平的升幅控制在 2°C 以内，并努力将其限制在 1.5°C 之内。

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: 每隔几年，各国都会被要求提交更新的国家气候计划，即国家自主贡献（NDCs）。

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: 每届 COP 都是对这些计划及其背后资金进展情况的一次检验。

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: COP31 还因其不寻常的结构而引人注目。

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: 土耳其是主办国，而在两个竞标国达成的妥协下，澳大利亚在主持谈判中发挥领导作用。

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: 观察人士将密切关注这种共享安排在实践中如何运作，以及面临一些最直接气候风险的太平洋岛国在此过程中拥有多大话语权。

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. 减排承诺：差距正在缩小吗？

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: 每届 COP 的核心紧张局势在于各国承诺的目标与科学家认为需要的目标之间的差距。

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: 联合国最近的评估发现，即使当前的承诺得到充分兑现，世界仍将大幅超出 1.5°C 的目标，并且人们普遍预计气温限制至少会被暂时突破。

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 看点：

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **哪些国家提交了更新的计划，以及它们的雄心如何。** 一些排放大国提交偏晚，或者提出的目标被分析人士认为较为温和。

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **计划是否覆盖整个经济领域和所有温室气体。** 更广泛的目标更容易追踪和问责。

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **任何重新审视弱目标的机制。** 最有意义的成果将是一个鼓励各国在下一轮之前加强其计划的机制，而不仅是一份关切声明。

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. 气候资金：谁出资，出多少？

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: 资金通常是最艰难的议题。

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: 发展中国家主张，富裕的、历史排放量较高的国家必须提供资金以减少排放并适应气候变化的影响。

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: 出资国则指明预算紧张，并主张私人资本和新兴经济体也应做出贡献。

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: 关键分歧点：

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **现有承诺的落实。** 在巴库举行的 2024 年峰会上，各国就一项新目标达成一致，即到 2035 年每年至少提供 $300 billion，作为从所有渠道每年动员 $1.3 trillion 更广泛雄心的一部分。许多发展中国家称这远远不够。预计围绕承诺将如何被追踪以及是否按时兑现将展开辩论。

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **适应资金。** 帮助社区应对洪水、高温、干旱和海平面上升的资金一直落后于减排资金。谈判代表将寻求更明确的目标和时间表。

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **损失与损害。** 旨在帮助脆弱国家从气候灾难中恢复的基金在早些时候的峰会上成立。现在的焦点在于该基金持有多少资金、放款速度有多快以及谁有资格申请。

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **赠款与贷款。** 发展中国家多次警告，以贷款形式提供的融资会增加债务负担。赠款与贷款的比例是一个低调但重要的细节。

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. 美国的角色

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: 美国是全球历史上最大的排放国，也是气候资金的主要来源。

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: 在现任政府领导下，美国对国际气候合作的态度发生了显着转变，包括正式退出《巴黎协定》。

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: 这引发了几个实际问题：

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **资金缺口。** 如果美国贡献的公共资金减少，其他国家或私人投资者能否填补这一缺口？

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **外交影响力。** 美国存在感削弱可能会为包括欧盟、中国和大型发展中经济体在内的其他力量腾出空间，以塑造最终成果。

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **华盛顿之外的行动。** 美国的州政府、城市和企业表示，他们将继续各自的气候努力。关注这些群体在安塔利亚的显眼程度，以及他们的承诺是否具体且可衡量。

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: 理性的人们对最佳气候政策以及任何单一国家的恰当角色存在分歧。

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: 对读者来说，重要的是美国立场的改变如何影响就资金和雄心达成协议的概率。

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. 化石燃料与能源转型

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: 在近期的峰会上，各国原则上同意在能源系统中摆脱化石燃料，但将这一表述转化为具体步骤一直充满争议。

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: 生产国和消费国在时间安排、公平性以及天然气的角色方面存在分歧。

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: 关注重点：

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **路线图或时间表。** 谈判代表是否就规划转型过程达成一致，即使没有具有约束力的日期。

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **可再生能源和效率目标。** 早期承诺要求到 2030 年将可再生能源装机容量增至三倍，并将能效提升速度翻倍。进展报告将显示全球是否走在正轨上。

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **对工人与社区的支持。** “公正转型”包括为依赖煤炭、石油和天然气的地区提供再培训和经济支持。

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. 议程上的其他事项

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **碳市场。** 各国与企业之间排放配额交易的规则仍在不断完善。质量和透明度是主要关切。

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **追踪适应进展。** 各国正在制定指标，以衡量社区应对气候影响的准备程度。

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **森林、甲烷和其他特定领域的倡议。** 这些倡议通常在会外宣布，尽管通常是自愿性质的，但可以带来实质性的减排。

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## 什么样的成果才算实质性进展

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: 峰会公报听起来可能包罗万象。

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: 几个标志有助于区分实质内容与象征意义：

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **数字和日期，而不仅仅是意向。** 具体的资金金额、交付日程和报告要求。

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **问责制。** 检查承诺是否得到履行的高效清晰途径。

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **排放大国更新或加强的国家计划**，特别是那些全球排放份额最大的国家。

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **真正落实到基层的资金。** 需要资金的国家和社区可以获取的资金。

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **可信的后续跟进。** 包含在下一届 COP 之前落实行动流程的决策。

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: 相比之下，模糊的措辞、推迟的决定和无资金支持的承诺则是进展有限的迹象。

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## 如何关注大会动态

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - 联合国气候变化框架公约会发布官方更新和每日摘要。

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - 独立追踪机构（如研究机构运营的机构）评估各国的承诺和资金流动。

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - 声誉良好的新闻机构提供现场报道和分析。

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: 对比多个信息来源，对早期头条新闻保持谨慎态度。

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: 最终文本中的细节往往比最初的声明更重要。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: COP31 不太可能解决所有争议，但它可以明确各国打算如何缩小承诺与行动之间的差距、由谁来埋单，以及在政治格局变化中国际合作能否维系。

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: 密切关注资金数字、国家计划的力度以及关于化石燃料的措辞。

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: 与任何单一的头条新闻相比，这些更能说明本届峰会的影响力。

segments.tr: 日期、议程和谈判立场可能会有变化。*

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## COP31 क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: 2015 के पेरिस समझौते ने पूर्व-औद्योगिक स्तरों से 2°C से काफी नीचे ग्लोबल वार्मिंग को रखने का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया, जबकि इसे 1.5°C तक सीमित करने के प्रयास जारी रखे।

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक COP इस बात की जांच है कि वे योजनाएं, और उनके पीछे का पैसा, कैसे आगे बढ़ रहे हैं।

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: COP31 अपनी असामान्य संरचना के लिए भी उल्लेखनीय है।

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: तुर्की मेजबान देश है, जबकि दो बोलीदाताओं के बीच हुए समझौते के तहत ऑस्ट्रेलिया को वार्ता चलाने में अग्रणी भूमिका दी गई थी।

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: पर्यवेक्षक यह देखेंगे कि वह साझा व्यवस्था व्यवहार में कैसे काम करती है, और प्रशांत द्वीप राष्ट्र, जो कुछ सबसे तत्काल जलवायु जोखिमों का सामना कर रहे हैं, इस प्रक्रिया में कितना वजन रखते हैं।

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. उत्सर्जन प्रतिज्ञाएं: क्या अंतर कम हो रहा है?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: हर COP में केंद्रीय तनाव उस अंतर के बारे में है जो देशों ने वादा किया है और जो वैज्ञानिक कहते हैं कि आवश्यक है।

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: हाल के संयुक्त राष्ट्र आकलन में पाया गया है कि वर्तमान प्रतिज्ञाएं, यदि पूरी तरह से पूरी भी हो जाएं, तो भी दुनिया को 1.5°C के लक्ष्य से काफी ऊपर छोड़ देंगी, और तापमान सीमा के कम से कम अस्थायी रूप से पार होने की व्यापक रूप से उम्मीद है।

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: क्या देखना है:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **किन देशों ने अद्यतन योजनाएं प्रस्तुत की हैं, और वे कितनी महत्वाकांक्षी हैं।** कुछ प्रमुख उत्सर्जकों ने देर से या ऐसे लक्ष्यों के साथ फाइल किया जिन्हें विश्लेषक मामूली मानते हैं।

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **क्या योजनाएं पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था और सभी ग्रीनहाउस गैसों को कवर करती हैं।** व्यापक लक्ष्यों को ट्रैक करना और जवाबदेह बनाना आसान होता है।

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **कमजोर लक्ष्यों पर पुनर्विचार करने की कोई प्रक्रिया।** सबसे सार्थक परिणाम एक ऐसा तंत्र होगा जो देशों को अगले दौर से पहले अपनी योजनाओं को मजबूत करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करे, न कि केवल चिंता का बयान।

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. जलवायु वित्त: कौन भुगतान करता है, और कितना?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: पैसा आमतौर पर सबसे कठिन विषय होता है।

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: विकासशील देशों का तर्क है कि अमीर, ऐतिहासिक रूप से उच्च उत्सर्जन करने वाले देशों को उत्सर्जन में कटौती करने और जलवायु परिवर्तन के प्रभावों के अनुकूल होने के लिए धन प्रदान करना चाहिए।

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: दाता देश तंग बजट की ओर इशारा करते हैं और तर्क देते हैं कि निजी पूंजी और उभरती अर्थव्यवस्थाओं को भी योगदान देना चाहिए।

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: घर्षण के मुख्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **मौजूदा वादों की डिलीवरी।** बाकू में 2024 के शिखर सम्मेलन में, देशों ने 2035 तक प्रति वर्ष कम से कम $300 बिलियन के नए लक्ष्य पर सहमति व्यक्त की, जो सभी स्रोतों से सालाना $1.3 ट्रिलियन जुटाने की व्यापक महत्वाकांक्षा के भीतर है। कई विकासशील देशों ने इसे अपर्याप्त बताया। इस बात पर बहस की उम्मीद करें कि प्रतिज्ञाओं को कैसे ट्रैक किया जाएगा और क्या वे समय पर पूरी होती हैं।

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **अनुकूलन फंडिंग।** बाढ़, गर्मी, सूखे और समुद्र के स्तर में वृद्धि से निपटने में समुदायों की मदद करने के लिए पैसा उत्सर्जन कटौती के लिए फंडिंग से पीछे रह गया है। वार्ताकार स्पष्ट लक्ष्यों और समयसीमा की तलाश करेंगे।

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **नुकसान और क्षति।** जलवायु आपदाओं से उबरने में कमजोर देशों की मदद करने के लिए एक फंड पिछले शिखर सम्मेलनों में बनाया गया था। अब सवाल यह है कि इसमें कितना है, यह कितनी जल्दी भुगतान करता है और कौन योग्य है।

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **अनुदान बनाम ऋण।** विकासशील देशों ने बार-बार चेतावनी दी है कि ऋण के रूप में दिया गया वित्तपोषण ऋण के बोझ को बढ़ा सकता है। अनुदान और ऋण का मिश्रण एक शांत लेकिन महत्वपूर्ण विवरण है।

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका की भूमिका

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा ऐतिहासिक उत्सर्जक और जलवायु वित्त का एक प्रमुख स्रोत है।

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय जलवायु सहयोग के प्रति इसका रुख वर्तमान प्रशासन के तहत स्पष्ट रूप से बदल गया है, जिसमें पेरिस समझौते से औपचारिक वापसी भी शामिल है।

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: यह कई व्यावहारिक प्रश्न उठाता है:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **फंडिंग अंतराल।** यदि अमेरिका कम सार्वजनिक धन का योगदान देता है, तो क्या अन्य देश या निजी निवेशक कमी को पूरा कर सकते हैं?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **राजनयिक लाभ।** कम अमेरिकी उपस्थिति यूरोपीय संघ, चीन और बड़ी विकासशील अर्थव्यवस्थाओं सहित अन्य शक्तियों के लिए परिणाम को आकार देने की जगह खोल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **वाशिंगटन से परे कार्रवाई।** अमेरिका में राज्य सरकारों, शहरों और कंपनियों ने कहा है कि वे अपने स्वयं के जलवायु प्रयास जारी रखेंगे। देखें कि अंताल्या में वे समूह कितने दृश्यमान हैं और क्या उनकी प्रतिबद्धताएं विशिष्ट और मापने योग्य हैं।

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: उचित लोग सर्वोत्तम जलवायु नीति और किसी भी एक देश के लिए सही भूमिका के बारे में असहमत हैं।

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: पाठकों के लिए जो मायने रखता है वह यह है कि बदलती अमेरिकी स्थिति वित्त और महत्वाकांक्षा पर समझौतों तक पहुंचने की संभावनाओं को कैसे प्रभावित करती है।

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. जीवाश्म ईंधन और ऊर्जा संक्रमण

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: हाल के शिखर सम्मेलनों में, देशों ने सिद्धांत रूप में ऊर्जा प्रणालियों में जीवाश्म ईंधन से दूर जाने पर सहमति व्यक्त की है, लेकिन उस भाषा को ठोस कदमों में बदलना विवादास्पद रहा है।

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: उत्पादक और उपभोक्ता देश समय, निष्पक्षता और प्राकृतिक गैस की भूमिका पर असहमत हैं।

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: इनके लिए देखें:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **एक रोडमैप या समयरेखा।** क्या वार्ताकार संक्रमण की योजना बनाने की प्रक्रिया पर सहमत हैं, भले ही बाध्यकारी तिथियों के बिना।

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा और दक्षता के लिए लक्ष्य।** पिछली प्रतिबद्धताओं में 2030 तक नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा क्षमता को तीन गुना करने और दक्षता सुधार की गति को दोगुना करने का आह्वान किया गया था। प्रगति रिपोर्ट दिखाएगी कि क्या दुनिया सही रास्ते पर है।

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **श्रमिकों और समुदायों के लिए समर्थन।** एक "न्यायसंगत संक्रमण" में कोयला, तेल और गैस पर निर्भर क्षेत्रों के लिए पुन: प्रशिक्षण और आर्थिक सहायता शामिल है।

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. एजेंडे पर अन्य आइटम

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **कार्बन बाजार।** देशों और कंपनियों के बीच उत्सर्जन क्रेडिट के व्यापार के नियमों को परिष्कृत किया जाना जारी है। गुणवत्ता और पारदर्शिता मुख्य चिंताएं हैं।

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **अनुकूलन पर प्रगति को ट्रैक करना।** देश यह मापने के लिए संकेतकों पर काम कर रहे हैं कि समुदाय जलवायु प्रभावों के लिए कितनी अच्छी तरह तैयारी कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **वन, मीथेन और अन्य क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट पहल।** इनकी घोषणा अक्सर साइडलाइन पर की जाती है और ये वास्तविक कटौती प्रदान कर सकते हैं, हालांकि वे आमतौर पर स्वैच्छिक होते हैं।

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## वास्तविक परिणाम के रूप में क्या गिना जाएगा

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: शिखर सम्मेलन के विज्ञप्ति व्यापक लग सकते हैं।

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: कुछ मार्कर प्रतीकवाद से पदार्थ को अलग करने में मदद करते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **संख्याएं और तिथियां, न कि केवल इरादे।** विशिष्ट वित्त राशि, वितरण कार्यक्रम और रिपोर्टिंग आवश्यकताएं।

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **जवाबदेही।** यह जांचने के स्पष्ट तरीके कि क्या वादे पूरे किए गए थे।

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **बड़े उत्सर्जकों से नई या मजबूत राष्ट्रीय योजनाएं**, विशेष रूप से वे जिनका वैश्विक उत्सर्जन में सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा है।

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **पैसा जो जमीन तक पहुंचता है।** ऐसे फंड जो उन देशों और समुदायों के लिए सुलभ हैं जिन्हें उनकी आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **विश्वसनीय अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई।** ऐसे निर्णय जिनमें अगले COP से पहले उन पर कार्य करने की प्रक्रिया शामिल हो।

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, अस्पष्ट भाषा, स्थगित निर्णय और बिना वित्त पोषित प्रतिज्ञाएं सीमित प्रगति के संकेत हैं।

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## साथ कैसे चलें

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - आधिकारिक अपडेट और दैनिक सारांश संयुक्त राष्ट्र जलवायु परिवर्तन द्वारा प्रकाशित किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - स्वतंत्र ट्रैकर्स, जैसे कि अनुसंधान संस्थानों द्वारा चलाए जाने वाले, राष्ट्रीय प्रतिज्ञाओं और वित्त प्रवाह का आकलन करते हैं।

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - प्रतिष्ठित समाचार संगठन ऑन-द-ग्राउंड रिपोर्टिंग और विश्लेषण प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: कई स्रोतों की तुलना करें, और शुरुआती सुर्खियों का सावधानी से इलाज करें।

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: अंतिम पाठ में विवरण अक्सर प्रारंभिक घोषणाओं से अधिक मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.

es.title: La COP31 está a dos semanas: qué observar en la cumbre climática de la ONU en Antalya, Turquía

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: Delegados de casi 200 países se están preparando para reunirse en Antalya, en la costa mediterránea de Turquía, para la COP31, la conferencia anual sobre el clima de las Naciones Unidas.

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: Las conversaciones están programadas para mediados de noviembre.

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: Cada cumbre se presenta como un punto de inflexión, y la mayoría termina en cambio en compromisos.

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, la pregunta útil no es si la COP31 "salvará el clima".

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: Sino qué decisiones específicas podrían cambiar lo que los gobiernos, las empresas y los inversores realmente hacen.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: Esta guía cubre los temas principales, los puntos de fricción y los resultados que vale la pena observar.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: Los detalles de la agenda aún pueden cambiar, así que consulta las actualizaciones oficiales de Cambio Climático de la ONU (UNFCCC) para ver el horario más reciente.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa la COP31

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: El Acuerdo de París de 2015 estableció el objetivo de mantener el calentamiento global muy por debajo de 2°C respecto a los niveles preindustriales, al tiempo que se persiguen esfuerzos para limitarlo a 1.5°C.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: Cada pocos años, se pide a los países que presenten planes climáticos nacionales actualizados, conocidos como contribuciones determinadas a nivel nacional (NDC).

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: Cada COP es un punto de control sobre cómo progresan esos planes y el dinero detrás de ellos.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: La COP31 también destaca por su estructura inusual.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: Turquía es el país anfitrión, mientras que a Australia se le dio un papel principal en la dirección de las negociaciones bajo un compromiso alcanzado entre los dos oferentes.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: Los observadores estarán atentos a cómo funciona en la práctica ese arreglo compartido y cuánto peso tienen en el proceso las naciones insulares del Pacífico, que enfrentan algunos de los riesgos climáticos más inmediatos.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. Compromisos de emisiones: ¿Se está cerrando la brecha?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: La tensión central en cada COP es la brecha entre lo que los países han prometido y lo que los científicos dicen que se necesita.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: Evaluaciones recientes de la ONU han encontrado que las promesas actuales, incluso si se cumplen por completo, aún dejarían al mundo muy por encima de la meta de 1.5°C, y se espera ampliamente que el límite de temperatura se supere al menos temporalmente.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Qué observar:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **Qué países han presentado planes actualizados y cuán ambiciosos son.** Algunos grandes emisores presentaron tarde o con objetivos que los analistas consideran modestos.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **Si los planes cubren toda la economía y todos los gases de efecto invernadero.** Los objetivos más amplios son más fáciles de rastrear y de exigir rendición de cuentas.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **Cualquier proceso para revisar los objetivos débiles.** El resultado más significativo sería un mecanismo que anime a los países a fortalecer sus planes antes de la próxima ronda, no solo una declaración de preocupación.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. Financiación climática: ¿Quién paga y cuánto?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: El dinero suele ser el tema más difícil.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: Los países en desarrollo argumentan que las naciones más ricas y con mayores emisiones históricas deben proporcionar los fondos para reducir las emisiones y adaptarse a los efectos del cambio climático.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: Los países donantes señalan los presupuestos ajustados y argumentan que el capital privado y las economías emergentes también deben contribuir.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: Puntos clave de fricción:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **Entrega de las promesas existentes.** En la cumbre de 2024 en Bakú, los países acordaron una nueva meta de al menos $300 mil millones por año para 2035, dentro de una ambición más amplia de movilizar $1.3 billones anuales de todas las fuentes. Muchos países en desarrollo calificaron esto de insuficiente. Espere un debate sobre cómo se hará el seguimiento de las promesas y si se cumplen a tiempo.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **Financiación para la adaptación.** El dinero para ayudar a las comunidades a hacer frente a las inundaciones, el calor, la sequía y la elevación del nivel del mar se ha quedado rezagado con respecto a la financiación para la reducción de emisiones. Los negociadores buscarán objetivos y cronogramas más claros.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Pérdidas y daños.** En cumbres anteriores se creó un fondo para ayudar a los países vulnerables a recuperarse de los desastres climáticos. Las preguntas ahora son cuánto contiene, con qué rapidez desembolsa y quién califica.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **Subvenciones frente a préstamos.** Los países en desarrollo han advertido repetidamente que la financiación entregada como préstamos puede aumentar la carga de la deuda. La combinación de subvenciones y préstamos es un detalle silencioso pero importante.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. El papel de Estados Unidos

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos es el mayor emisor histórico del mundo y una fuente importante de financiación climática.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: Su postura hacia la cooperación climática internacional ha cambiado notablemente bajo la actual administración, incluida una retirada formal del Acuerdo de París.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: Eso plantea varias preguntas prácticas:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **Déficits de financiación.** Si EE. UU. aporta menos dinero público, ¿pueden otros países o inversores privados cubrir el déficit?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Apalancamiento diplomático.** Una menor presencia de EE. UU. puede abrir espacio para que otras potencias, incluida la Unión Europea, China y grandes economías en desarrollo, den forma al resultado.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **Acción más allá de Washington.** Los gobiernos estatales, las ciudades y las empresas en EE. UU. han dicho que continuarán con sus propios esfuerzos climáticos. Busque cuán visibles son esos grupos en Antalya y si sus compromisos son específicos y mensurables.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: Las personas razonables discrepan sobre la mejor política climática y sobre el papel correcto para cualquier país individual.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: Lo que importa para los lectores es cómo la cambiante posición de EE. UU. afecta las probabilidades de llegar a acuerdos sobre financiación y ambición.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. Combustibles fósiles y transición energética

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: En cumbres recientes, los países han acordado en principio alejarse de los combustibles fósiles en los sistemas energéticos, pero convertir ese lenguaje en pasos concretos ha sido polémico.

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: Las naciones productoras y consumidoras discrepan sobre el calendario, la equidad y el papel del gas natural.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: Observe:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **Una hoja de ruta o cronograma.** Si los negociadores acuerdan un proceso para planificar la transición, incluso sin fechas vinculantes.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **Objetivos para energías renovables y eficiencia.** Los compromisos anteriores exigían triplicar la capacidad de energía renovable y duplicar el ritmo de las mejoras de eficiencia para 2030. Los informes de progreso mostrarán si el mundo va por buen camino.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **Apoyo a los trabajadores y comunidades.** Una "transición justa" incluye la reconversión profesional y el apoyo económico para las regiones que dependen del carbón, el petróleo y el gas.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. Otros temas de la agenda

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **Mercados de carbono.** Se siguen perfeccionando las reglas para comerciar créditos de emisiones entre países y empresas. La calidad y la transparencia son las principales preocupaciones.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **Seguimiento del progreso en la adaptación.** Los países están trabajando en indicadores para medir qué tan bien se están preparando las comunidades para los impactos climáticos.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **Bosques, metano y otras iniciativas sectoriales específicas.** A menudo se anuncian al margen y pueden lograr reducciones reales, aunque suelen ser voluntarias.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## Qué se consideraría un resultado real

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: Los comunicados de las cumbres pueden sonar ambiciosos.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: Unos pocos marcadores ayudan a separar la sustancia del simbolismo:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **Números y fechas, no solo intenciones.** Cantidades específicas de financiación, calendarios de entrega y requisitos de presentación de informes.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **Rendición de cuentas.** Formas claras de comprobar si se cumplieron las promesas.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **Planes nacionales nuevos o fortalecidos** de los grandes emisores, especialmente aquellos con la mayor proporción de emisiones globales.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **Dinero que llega al terreno.** Fondos que sean accesibles para los países y comunidades que los necesitan.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **Seguimiento creíble.** Decisiones que incluyan un proceso para actuar sobre ellas antes de la próxima COP.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: Por el contrario, un lenguaje vago, decisiones aplazadas y promesas sin fondos son signos de un progreso limitado.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## Cómo seguir de cerca

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - Las actualizaciones oficiales y los resúmenes diarios son publicados por Cambio Climático de la ONU.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - Los rastreadores independientes, como los dirigidos por instituciones de investigación, evalúan los compromisos nacionales y los flujos financieros.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - Las organizaciones de noticias acreditadas ofrecen informes y análisis desde el terreno.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: Compare múltiples fuentes y trate los titulares iniciales con precaución.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: Los detalles en el texto final a menudo importan más que los anuncios iniciales.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: Es poco probable que la COP31 resuelva todas las disputas, pero podría aclarar cómo los países pretenden cerrar la brecha entre las promesas y la acción, quién pagará por ello y si la cooperación internacional puede mantenerse unida en medio de la política cambiante.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: Esté atento a las cifras de financiación, la solidez de los planes nacionales y el lenguaje sobre los combustibles fósiles.

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: Eso dirá más sobre el impacto de la cumbre que cualquier titular individual.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: التوتر الأساسي في كل مؤتمر للأطراف هو الفجوة بين ما وعدت به الدول وما يقول العلماء إنه مطلوب.

segments.src: What to watch:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **الدول التي قدمت خططًا محدثة ومدى طموحها.** قدم بعض كبار المطلاسين خططهم متأخرة أو بأهداف يعتبرها المحللون متواضعة.

segments.tr: - **ما إذا كانت الخطط تغطي الاقتصاد بأكمله وجميع غازات الدفيئة.** الأهداف الأوسع أسهل في التتبع والمحاسبة.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **أي عملية لإعادة النظر في الأهداف الضعيفة.** النتيجة الأكثر مغزى ستكون آلية تشجع الدول على تعزيز خططها قبل الجولة القادمة، وليس مجرد بيان قلق.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. تمويل المناخ: من يدفع، وكم المبلغ؟

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: عادة ما يكون المال هو الموضوع الأكثر صعوبة.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: تجادل الدول النامية بأن الدول الأكثر ثراءً والتي كانت تاريخياً أكثر إصداراً للانبعاثات يجب أن توفر الأموال لخفض الانبعاثات والتكيف مع آثار تغير المناخ.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: تشير الدول المانحة إلى الميزانيات المتقشفة وتجادل بأن رأس المال الخاص والاقتصادات الناشئة يجب أن تساهم أيضاً.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: نقاط الاحتكاك الرئيسية:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **تسليم الوعود الحالية.** في قمة 2024 في باكو، اتفقت الدول على هدف جديد يتمثل في ما لا يقل عن 300 مليار دولار سنويًا بحلول عام 2035، ضمن طموح أوسع لحشد 1.3 تريليون دولار سنويًا من جميع المصادر. ووصف العديد من الدول النامية هذا بأنه غير كافٍ. توقع حدوث نقاش حول كيفية تتبع التعهدات وما إذا كان يتم الوفاء بها في الوقت المحدد.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **تمويل التكيف.** لقد تراجع الأموال المخصصة لمساعدة المجتمعات على التعامل مع الفيضانات والحرارة والجفاف وارتفاع مستوى سطح البحر عن التمويل المخصص لخفض الانبعاثات. سيبحث المفاوضون عن أهداف وجداول زمنية أكثر وضوحًا.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **الخسائر والأضرار.** تم إنشاء صندوق لمساعدة الدول الضعيفة على التعافي من كارثة المناخ في قمم سابقة. الأسئلة الآن هي كم يحمل، ومدى سرعة صرفه، ومن المؤهل.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **المنح مقابل القروض.** حذرت الدول النامية مراراً وتكراراً من أن التمويل المقدم في صورة قروض يمكن أن يضيف إلى أعباء الديون. مزيج المنح والقروض هو تفصيل هادئ ولكنه مهم.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. دور الولايات المتحدة

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: الولايات المتحدة هي أكبر مصدر تاريخي للانبعاثات في العالم ومصدر رئيسي لتمويل المناخ.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: لقد تحول موقفها تجاه التعاون المناخي الدولي بشكل ملحوظ في ظل الإدارة الحالية، بما في ذلك الانسحاب الرسمي من اتفاق باريس.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: هذا يثير عدة أسئلة عملية:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **فجوات التمويل.** إذا ساهمت الولايات المتحدة بأموال عامة أقل، فهل يمكن لدول أخرى أو مستثمرين خاصين سد النقص؟

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **النفوذ الدبلوماسي.** قد يفتح تقليص الحضور الأمريكي المجال أمام قوى أخرى، بما في ذلك الاتحاد الأوروبي والصين والاقتصادات النامية الكبرى، لتشكيل النتيجة.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **العمل خارج واشنطن.** قالت حكومات الولايات والمدن والشركات في الولايات المتحدة إنها ستواصل جهودها المناخية الخاصة. ابحث عن مدى بروز تلك المجموعات في أنطاليا وما إذا كانت التزاماتهم محددة وقابلة للقياس.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: يختلف الأشخاص العقلاء حول أفضل سياسة مناخية وحول الدور الصحيح لأي دولة واحدة.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: ما يهم القراء هو كيف يؤثر الموقف الأمريكي المتغير على احتمالات التوصل إلى اتفاقات بشأن التمويل والطموح.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. الوقود الأحفوري والتحول في قطاع الطاقة

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: في القمم الأخيرة، اتفقت الدول من المبدأ على الابتعاد عن الوقود الأحفوري في أنظمة الطاقة، لكن تحويل هذه اللغة إلى خطوات ملموسة كان مثار جدل.

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: تختلف الدول المنتجة والمستهلكة في التوقيت والعدالة ودور الغاز الطبيعي.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: راقب ما يلي:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **خريطة طريق أو جدول زمني.** ما إذا كان المفاوضون يتفقون على عملية لتخطيط الانتقال، حتى بدون تواريخ ملزمة.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **أهداف الطاقات المتجددة والكفاءة.** دعت التزامات سابقة إلى مضاعفة سعة الطاقة المتجددة ثلاث مرات ومضاعفة وتيرة تحسينات الكفاءة بحلول عام 2030. ستظهر تقارير التقدم ما إذا كان العالم على المسار الصحيح.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **دعم العمال والمجتمعات.** يتضمن "الانتقال العادل" إعادة التدريب والدعم الاقتصادي للمناطق التي تعتمد على الفحم والنفط والغاز.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. بنود أخرى على جدول الأعمال

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **أسواق الكربون.** لا يزال يتم تحسين قواعد تداول ائتمانات الانبعاثات بين الدول والشركات. الجودة والشفافية هما الشغفان الرئيسيان.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **تتبع التقدم المحرز في التكيف.** تعمل الدول على مؤشرات لقياس مدى استعداد المجتمعات لآثار المناخ.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **الغابات والميثان وغيرها من المبادرات الخاصة بالقطاعات.** وغالباً ما يتم الإعلان عنها على الهامش ويمكن أن تحقق تخفيضات حقيقية، على الرغم من أنها تطوعية عادةً.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يمكن اعتباره نتيجة حقيقية

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تبدو بيانات القمم واسعة النطاق.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: تساعد بعض العلامات في فصل الجوهر عن الرمزية:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **الأرقام والتواريخ وليس النوايا فقط.** مبالغ تمويل محددة، وجداول تسليم ومتطلبات إعداد التقارير.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **المساءلة.** طرق واضحة للتحقق مما إذا تم الوفاء بالوعود.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **خطط وطنية جديدة أو معززة** من كبار مصدري الانبعاثات، وخاصة أولئك الذين لديهم أكبر حصة من الانبعاثات العالمية.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **الأموال التي تصل إلى أرض الواقع.** الأموال التي يمكن الوصول إليها من قبل الدول والمجتمعات التي تحتاج إليها.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **متابعة ذات مصداقية.** القرارات التي تتضمن عملية للعمل عليها قبل مؤتمر الأطراف القادم.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: في المقابل، فإن اللغة الغامضة، والقرارات المؤجلة، والتعهدات غير المמוولة هي علامات على تقدم محدود.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## كيفية المتابعة

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - يتم نشر التحديثات الرسمية والملخصات اليومية من قِبل تغير المناخ التابع للأمم المتحدة.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - تقوم المتتبعات المستقلة، مثل تلك التي تديرها المؤسسات البحثية، بتقييم التعهدات الوطنية وتدفقات التمويل.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - تقدم المؤسسات الإخبارية ذات السمعة الطيبة تقارير وتحليلات من أرض الواقع.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: قارن بين مصادر متعددة، وتعامل بحذر مع العناوين الرئيسية المبكرة.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: التفاصيل في النص النهائي غالبًا ما تكون أكثر أهمية من الإعلانات الأولية.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: من غير المرجح أن يحل مؤتمر (COP31) كل نزاع، لكنه قد يوضح كيف تنوي الدول سد الفجوة بين الوعود والعمل، ومن سيتحمل تكلفتها، وما إذا كان التعاون الدولي قادرًا على الصمود وسط السياسات المتغيرة.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: راقب أرقام التمويل، وقوة الخطط الوطنية، ولغة الوقود الأحفوري.

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: ستعبر هذه الأشياء عن تأثير القمة أكثر من أي عنوان رئيسي فردي.
