segments.tr: قد تتغير التواريخ وجداول الأعمال ومواقف التفاوض.*

fr.title: La COP31 approche à grands pas : ce qu'il faut surveiller lors du sommet de l'ONU sur le climat à Antalya, en Turquie

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: Des délégués de près de 200 pays s'apprêtent à se réunir à Antalya, sur la côte méditerranéenne de la Turquie, pour la COP31, la conférence annuelle des Nations unies sur le climat.

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: Les discussions sont prévues pour la mi-novembre.

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: Chaque sommet est présenté comme un tournant, et la plupart se solde par des compromis.

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: La question utile n'est donc pas de savoir si la COP31 va "sauver le climat".

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de savoir quelles décisions spécifiques pourraient modifier ce que font réellement les gouvernements, les entreprises et les investisseurs.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: Ce guide couvre les principaux enjeux, les points de friction et les résultats à suivre.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: Les détails de l'ordre du jour pouvant encore évoluer, consultez les mises à jour officielles de l'ONU Changement climatique (CCNUCC) pour connaître le dernier calendrier.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la COP31 est importante

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: L'Accord de Paris de 2015 s'est fixé pour objectif de maintenir le réchauffement climatique bien en dessous de 2°C par rapport aux niveaux préindustriels, tout en poursuivant les efforts pour le limiter à 1,5°C.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: Tous les quelques ans, les pays sont invités à soumettre des plans climatiques nationaux actualisés, connus sous le nom de contributions déterminées au niveau national (CDN).

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: Chaque COP est un point de contrôle sur la progression de ces plans et des financements qui les soutiennent.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: La COP31 se distingue également par sa structure inhabituelle.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: La Turquie est le pays hôte, tandis que l'Australie s'est vu confier un rôle de premier plan dans la conduite des négociations dans le cadre d'un compromis trouvé entre les deux candidats.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: Les observateurs suivront la manière dont cet arrangement partagé fonctionne dans la pratique et le poids que pèsent les nations insulaires du Pacifique, qui font face à certains des risques climatiques les plus immédiats, dans le processus.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. Engagements en matière d'émissions : L'écart se réduit-il ?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: La tension centrale de chaque COP réside dans l'écart entre ce que les pays ont promis et ce que les scientifiques jugent nécessaire.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: Les récentes évaluations de l'ONU ont révélé que les engagements actuels, même s'ils étaient entièrement respectés, laisseraient le monde bien au-dessus de l'objectif de 1,5°C, et la limite de température devrait être dépassée, au moins temporairement.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: À surveiller :

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **Quels pays ont soumis des plans actualisés et quel est leur niveau d'ambition.** Certains grands émetteurs ont déposé leur dossier en retard ou avec des objectifs jugés modestes par les analystes.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **Si les plans couvrent l'ensemble de l'économie et tous les gaz à effet de serre.** Des objectifs plus larges sont plus faciles à suivre et à rendre responsables.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **Tout processus de révision des objectifs faibles.** Le résultat le plus significatif serait un mécanisme qui encourage les pays à renforcer leurs plans avant le prochain cycle, et non pas seulement une déclaration de préoccupation.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. Finance climat : Qui paie, et combien ?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: L'argent est généralement le sujet le plus difficile.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: Les pays en développement soutiennent que les nations les plus riches et historiquement les plus émettrices doivent fournir les fonds nécessaires pour réduire les émissions et s'adapter aux effets du changement climatique.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: Les pays donateurs soulignent la contrainte budgétaire et avancent que les capitaux privés et les économies émergentes doivent également contribuer.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: Principaux points de friction :

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **Versement des promesses existantes.** Lors du sommet de 2024 à Bakou, les pays se sont mis d'accord sur un nouvel objectif d'au moins 300 milliards de dollars par an d'ici 2035, dans le cadre d'une ambition plus large de mobiliser 1 300 milliards de dollars par an provenant de toutes les sources. De nombreux pays en développement ont jugé cela insuffisant. Attendez-vous à un débat sur la manière dont les engagements seront suivis et s'ils seront tenus dans les délais.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **Financement de l'adaptation.** L'argent destiné à aider les communautés à faire face aux inondations, à la chaleur, à la sécheresse et à la montée des eaux a pris du retard par rapport au financement des réductions d'émissions. Les négociateurs rechercheront des objectifs et des calendriers plus précis.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Pertes et préjudices.** Un fonds destiné à aider les pays vulnérables à se remettre des catastrophes climatiques a été créé lors des sommets précédents. Les questions actuelles portent sur son montant, la rapidité de ses décaissements et les critères d'éligibilité.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **Dons versus prêts.** Les pays en développement ont averti à plusieurs reprises que les financements accordés sous forme de prêts pouvaient alourdir le fardeau de la dette. La composition entre dons et prêts est un détail discret mais important.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. Le rôle des États-Unis

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis sont le plus grand émetteur historique au monde et une source majeure de finance climat.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: Leur position à l'égard de la coopération climatique internationale a nettement évolué sous l'administration actuelle, incluant un retrait formel de l'Accord de Paris.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: Cela soulève plusieurs questions pratiques :

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **Déficits de financement.** Si les États-Unis contribuent moins de fonds publics, d'autres pays ou des investisseurs privés peuvent-ils combler le manque à gagner ?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Influence diplomatique.** Une présence américaine réduite pourrait laisser de la place à d'autres puissances, notamment l'Union européenne, la Chine et de grandes économies en développement, pour façonner l'issue.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **Action au-delà de Washington.** Les gouvernements d'États, les villes et les entreprises aux États-Unis ont déclaré qu'ils poursuivraient leurs propres efforts climatiques. Observez la visibilité de ces groupes à Antalya et si leurs engagements sont précis et mesurables.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: Des personnes raisonnables peuvent être en désaccord sur la meilleure politique climatique et sur le rôle approprié pour un pays donné.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: Ce qui importe pour les lecteurs, c'est la façon dont l'évolution de la position américaine affecte les chances de parvenir à des accords sur la finance et l'ambition.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. Énergies fossiles et transition énergétique

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: Lors des récents sommets, les pays ont convenu en principe de s'éloigner des combustibles fossiles dans les systèmes énergétiques, mais la traduction de ce langage en mesures concrètes a été conflictuelle.

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: Les pays producteurs et consommateurs sont en désaccord sur le calendrier, l'équité et le rôle du gaz naturel.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: À surveiller :

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **Une feuille de route ou un calendrier.** La question de savoir si les négociateurs s'entendent sur un processus de planification de la transition, même sans dates contraignantes.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **Objectifs en matière d'énergies renouvelables et d'efficacité.** Les engagements antérieurs appelaient à tripler la capacité des énergies renouvelables et à doubler le rythme des améliorations de l'efficacité énergétique d'ici 2030. Les rapports d'étape montreront si le monde est sur la bonne voie.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **Soutien aux travailleurs et aux communautés.** Une "transition juste" comprend la reconversion et le soutien économique pour les régions qui dépendent du charbon, du pétrole et du gaz.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. Autres points à l'ordre du jour

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **Marchés du carbone.** Les règles régissant l'échange de crédits d'émissions entre pays et entreprises continuent d'être affinées. La qualité et la transparence sont les principales préoccupations.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **Suivi des progrès en matière d'adaptation.** Les pays travaillent sur des indicateurs pour mesurer dans quelle mesure les communautés se préparent aux impacts climatiques.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **Forêts, méthane et autres initiatives sectorielles.** Celles-ci sont souvent annoncées en marge et peuvent permettre de réelles réductions, bien qu'elles soient généralement volontaires.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## Ce qui constituerait un véritable résultat

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: Les communiqués de sommet peuvent sembler vastes.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: Quelques repères aident à séparer le fond du symbolisme :

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **Des chiffres et des dates, pas seulement des intentions.** Des montants financiers précis, des calendriers de versement et des exigences de reporting.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **Responsabilité.** Des moyens clairs pour vérifier si les promesses ont été tenues.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **Des plans nationaux nouveaux ou renforcés** de la part des grands émetteurs, en particulier ceux qui détiennent la plus grande part des émissions mondiales.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **De l'argent qui arrive sur le terrain.** Des fonds qui sont accessibles aux pays et aux communautés qui en ont besoin.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **Un suivi crédible.** Des décisions qui incluent un processus pour les mettre en œuvre avant la prochaine COP.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: En revanche, un langage vague, des décisions différées et des promesses non financées sont le signe de progrès limités.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## Comment suivre l'événement

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - Les mises à jour officielles et les résumés quotidiens sont publiés par l'ONU Changement climatique.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - Des observateurs indépendants, tels que ceux gérés par des instituts de recherche, évaluent les engagements nationaux et les flux financiers.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - Des organisations de presse réputées proposent des reportages et des analyses sur le terrain.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: Comparez de multiples sources et traitez les premiers gros titres avec prudence.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: Les détails du texte final comptent souvent plus que les annonces initiales.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: Il est peu probable que la COP31 résolve tous les litiges, mais elle pourrait clarifier la manière dont les pays comptent combler l'écart entre les promesses et l'action, qui paiera pour cela et si la coopération internationale peut tenir bon au milieu de la volubilité politique.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: Gardez un œil sur les chiffres de la finance, la force des plans nationaux et le langage sur les combustibles fossiles.

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: Ceux-ci en diront plus sur l'impact du sommet que n'importe quel titre de journal.

pt.title: A COP31 está a duas semanas: o que observar na cúpula do clima da ONU em Antalya, Turquia

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: Delegados de quase 200 países estão se preparando para se reunir em Antalya, na costa mediterrânea da Turquia, para a COP31, a conferência anual das Nações Unidas sobre o clima.

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: As negociações estão agendadas para meados de novembro.

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: Cada cúpula é anunciada como um ponto de virada, e a maioria termina em compromisso.

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: Portanto, a pergunta útil não é se a COP31 vai "salvar o clima".

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: É quais decisões específicas poderiam mudar o que governos, empresas e investidores realmente fazem.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: Este guia cobre as principais questões, os pontos de discórdia e os resultados que valem a pena observar.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: Os detalhes da agenda ainda podem mudar, portanto, verifique as atualizações oficiais da ONU sobre Mudanças Climáticas (UNFCCC) para o cronograma mais recente.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## Por que a COP31 é importante

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: O Acordo de Paris de 2015 estabeleceu a meta de manter o aquecimento global bem abaixo de 2°C acima dos níveis pré-industriais, enquanto busca esforços para limitá-lo a 1,5°C.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: A cada poucos anos, os países são solicitados a enviar planos climáticos nacionais atualizados, conhecidos como contribuições determinadas nacionalmente (NDCs).

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: Cada COP é um ponto de verificação sobre como esses planos, e o dinheiro por trás deles, estão progredindo.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: A COP31 também é notável por sua estrutura incomum.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: A Turquia é o país anfitrião, enquanto a Austrália recebeu um papel de liderança na condução das negociações sob um compromisso alcançado entre os dois licitantes.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: Os observadores estarão atentos a como esse arranjo compartilhado funciona na prática e quanto peso as nações insulares do Pacífico, que enfrentam alguns dos riscos climáticos mais imediatos, carregam no processo.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. Promessas de emissões: O abismo está diminuindo?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: A tensão central em cada COP é o abismo entre o que os países prometeram e o que os cientistas dizem ser necessário.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: Avaliações recentes da ONU constataram que as promessas atuais, mesmo que totalmente cumpridas, ainda deixariam o mundo bem acima da meta de 1,5°C, e espera-se amplamente que o limite de temperatura seja excedido, pelo menos temporariamente.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: O que observar:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **Quais países enviaram planos atualizados e quão ambiciosos eles são.** Alguns grandes emissores apresentaram planos atrasados ou com metas que os analistas consideram modestas.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **Se os planos cobrem toda a economia e todos os gases de efeito estufa.** Metas mais amplas são mais fáceis de rastrear e responsabilizar.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **Qualquer processo para revisar metas fracas.** O resultado mais significativo seria um mecanismo que incentive os países a fortalecer seus planos antes da próxima rodada, não apenas uma declaração de preocupação.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. Financiamento climático: Quem paga e quanto?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: Dinheiro é geralmente o tópico mais difícil.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: Os países em desenvolvimento argumentam que as nações mais ricas e historicamente maiores emissoras devem fornecer os fundos para reduzir as emissões e se adaptar aos efeitos das mudanças climáticas.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: Os países doadores apontam para orçamentos apertados e argumentam que o capital privado e as economias emergentes também devem contribuir.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: Principais pontos de atrito:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **Cumprimento das promessas existentes.** Na cúpula de 2024 em Baku, os países concordaram com uma nova meta de pelo menos US$ 300 bilhões por ano até 2035, dentro de uma ambição mais ampla de mobilizar US$ 1,3 trilhão anualmente de todas as fontes. Muitos países em desenvolvimento consideraram isso inadequado. Espere debate sobre como as promessas serão rastreadas e se serão cumpridas no prazo.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **Financiamento de adaptação.** O dinheiro para ajudar as comunidades a lidar com inundações, calor, seca e aumento do nível do mar ficou atrás do financiamento para cortes de emissões. Os negociadores buscarão metas e cronogramas mais claros.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Perdas e danos.** Um fundo para ajudar países vulneráveis a se recuperarem de desastres climáticos foi criado em cúpulas anteriores. As questões agora são quanto ele contém, com que rapidez paga e quem se qualifica.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **Subsídios versus empréstimos.** Os países em desenvolvimento alertaram repetidamente que o financiamento entregue como empréstimos pode aumentar os encargos da dívida. A combinação de subsídios e empréstimos é um detalhe silencioso, mas importante.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. O papel dos Estados Unidos

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: Os Estados Unidos são o maior emissor histórico do mundo e uma grande fonte de financiamento climático.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: Sua postura em relação à cooperação climática internacional mudou significativamente sob a atual administração, incluindo uma retirada formal do Acordo de Paris.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: Isso levanta várias questões práticas:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **Lacunas de financiamento.** Se os EUA contribuírem com menos dinheiro público, outros países ou investidores privados podem preencher o déficit?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Alavancagem diplomática.** Uma presença reduzida dos EUA pode abrir espaço para outras potências, incluindo a União Europeia, a China e grandes economias em desenvolvimento, moldarem o resultado.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **Ação além de Washington.** Governos estaduais, cidades e empresas nos EUA disseram que continuarão seus próprios esforços climáticos. Observe quão visíveis esses grupos são em Antalya e se seus compromissos são específicos e mensuráveis.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: Pessoas razoáveis discordam sobre a melhor política climática e sobre o papel certo para qualquer país individual.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: O que importa para os leitores é como a mudança na posição dos EUA afeta as chances de chegar a acordos sobre finanças e ambição.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. Combustíveis fósseis e transição energética

segments.tr: Em cúpulas recentes, os países concordaram em princípio em se afastar dos combustíveis fósseis nos sistemas de energia, mas transformar essa linguagem em passos concretos tem sido contencioso.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: Observe:

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **Metas para energias renováveis e eficiência.** Compromissos anteriores pediam a triplicação da capacidade de energia renovável e a duplicação do ritmo de melhorias na eficiência até 2030. Relatórios de progresso mostrarão se o mundo está no caminho certo.

segments.tr: - **Apoio aos trabalhadores e comunidades.** Uma "transição justa" inclui requalificação e apoio econômico para regiões que dependem de carvão, petróleo e gás.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. Outros itens na agenda

segments.tr: - **Mercados de carbono.** As regras para negociar créditos de emissão entre países e empresas continuam sendo refinadas. Qualidade e transparência são as principais preocupações.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.

segments.tr: Melainkan keputusan spesifik apa yang dapat mengubah tindakan nyata pemerintah, perusahaan, dan investor.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: Panduan ini mencakup isu-isu utama, poin-poin perdebatan, dan hasil yang layak untuk diperhatikan.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: Rincian agenda masih dapat berubah, jadi periksalah pembaruan resmi Perubahan Iklim PBB (UNFCCC) untuk jadwal terbaru.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## Mengapa COP31 Penting

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: Perjanjian Paris 2015 menetapkan sasaran untuk menjaga pemanasan global jauh di bawah 2°C di atas tingkat pra-industri, sambil mengupayakan pembatasannya hingga 1,5°C.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: Setiap beberapa tahun, negara-negara diminta untuk menyerahkan pembaruan rencana iklim nasional, yang dikenal sebagai kontribusi yang ditentukan secara nasional (NDC).

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: Setiap COP adalah pos pemeriksaan mengenai bagaimana rencana tersebut, dan dana di baliknya, mengalami kemajuan.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: COP31 juga patut dicatat karena strukturnya yang tidak biasa.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: Turki adalah negara tuan rumah, sementara Australia diberi peran utama dalam menjalankan negosiasi berdasarkan kompromi yang dicapai antara kedua pihak yang mengajukan diri.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: Para pengamat akan mengawasi bagaimana pengaturan bersama tersebut bekerja dalam praktiknya, dan seberapa besar pengaruh negara-negara pulau Pasifik, yang menghadapi beberapa risiko iklim paling langsung, dalam proses tersebut.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. Janji Emisi: Apakah Kesenjangan Ini Menyempit?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: Ketegangan utama di setiap COP adalah kesenjangan antara apa yang telah dijanjikan oleh negara-negara dan apa yang dikatakan para ilmuwan diperlukan.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: Penilaian terbaru PBB menemukan bahwa janji saat ini, bahkan jika dipenuhi sepenuhnya, masih akan membuat dunia jauh di atas target 1,5°C, dan batas suhu tersebut diperkirakan secara luas akan terlampaui setidaknya untuk sementara.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Hal yang perlu diperhatikan:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **Negara mana saja yang telah menyerahkan rencana yang diperbarui, dan seberapa ambisius rencana tersebut.** Beberapa negara dengan emisi besar mengajukan terlambat atau dengan target yang dianggap moderat oleh para analis.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **Apakah rencana tersebut mencakup seluruh perekonomian dan semua gas rumah kaca.** Target yang lebih luas lebih mudah dilacak dan dimintai pertanggungjawaban.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **Setiap proses untuk meninjau kembali target yang lemah.** Hasil yang paling berarti adalah mekanisme yang mendorong negara-negara untuk memperkuat rencana mereka sebelum putaran berikutnya, bukan sekadar pernyataan keprihatinan.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. Keuangan Iklim: Siapa yang Membayar, dan Berapa Banyak?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: Uang biasanya merupakan topik yang paling sulit.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: Negara-negara berkembang berpendapat bahwa negara-negara kaya yang secara historis memiliki emisi lebih tinggi harus menyediakan dana untuk memotong emisi dan beradaptasi dengan dampak perubahan iklim.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: Negara-negara donor menunjukkan anggaran yang ketat dan berpendapat bahwa modal swasta dan negara-negara berkembang juga harus berkontribusi.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: Poin-poin utama gesekan:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **Penyaluran janji yang ada.** Pada KTT 2024 di Baku, negara-negara menyepakati target baru setidaknya $300 miliar per tahun pada 2035, dalam ambisi yang lebih luas untuk memobilisasi $1,3 triliun setiap tahun dari semua sumber. Banyak negara berkembang menyebut ini tidak memadai. Harapkan perdebatan tentang bagaimana janji-janji tersebut akan dilacak dan apakah janji tersebut dipenuhi tepat waktu.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **Pendanaan adaptasi.** Dana untuk membantu masyarakat mengatasi banjir, panas, kekeringan, dan kenaikan permukaan laut tertinggal dari pendanaan untuk pemotongan emisi. Para negosiator akan mencari target dan jadwal yang lebih jelas.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Kerugian dan kerusakan.** Dana untuk membantu negara-negara rentan pulih dari bencana iklim dibuat pada KTT sebelumnya. Pertanyaannya sekarang adalah berapa banyak isinya, seberapa cepat dana tersebut dicairkan, dan siapa yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **Hibah versus pinjaman.** Negara-negara berkembang telah berulang kali memperingatkan bahwa pembiayaan yang diberikan sebagai pinjaman dapat menambah beban utang. Campuran hibah dan pinjaman adalah detail yang tenang namun penting.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. Peran Amerika Serikat

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: Amerika Serikat adalah penghasil emisi historis terbesar di dunia dan sumber utama pendanaan iklim.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: Sikapnya terhadap kerja sama iklim internasional telah bergeser secara nyata di bawah pemerintahan saat ini, termasuk penarikan diri secara resmi dari Perjanjian Paris.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: Hal itu menimbulkan beberapa pertanyaan praktis:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **Kesenjangan pendanaan.** Jika AS menyumbang lebih sedikit dana publik, dapatkah negara lain atau investor swasta mengisi kekurangan tersebut?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Pengaruh diplomatik.** Berkurangnya kehadiran AS dapat membuka ruang bagi kekuatan lain, termasuk Uni Eropa, Cina, dan negara-negara berkembang besar, untuk membentuk hasilnya.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **Tindakan di luar Washington.** Pemerintah negara bagian, kota, dan perusahaan di AS telah mengatakan bahwa mereka akan melanjutkan upaya iklim mereka sendiri. Perhatikan seberapa terlihat kelompok-kelompok tersebut di Antalya dan apakah komitmen mereka spesifik dan terukur.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: Orang-orang yang berpikiran sehat tidak sependapat tentang kebijakan iklim terbaik dan tentang peran yang tepat bagi satu negara pun.

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: Yang penting bagi para pembaca adalah bagaimana perubahan posisi AS memengaruhi peluang tercapainya kesepakatan mengenai keuangan dan ambisi.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. Bahan Bakar Fosil dan Transisi Energi

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: Pada KTT-KTT sebelumnya, negara-negara telah sepakat secara prinsip untuk beralih dari bahan bakar fosil dalam sistem energi, tetapi mengubah bahasa tersebut menjadi langkah-langkah konkrit telah menjadi hal yang kontroversial.

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: Negara produsen dan konsumen tidak sependapat mengenai waktu, keadilan, dan peran gas alam.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: Perhatikan:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **Peta jalan atau jadwal.** Apakah para negosiator menyetujui proses untuk merencanakan transisi, bahkan tanpa tanggal yang mengikat.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **Target untuk energi terbarukan dan efisiensi.** Komitmen sebelumnya menyerukan pelipatan tiga kapasitas energi terbarukan dan pelipatan dua laju peningkatan efisiensi pada 2030. Laporan kemajuan akan menunjukkan apakah dunia berada di jalur yang benar.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **Dukungan bagi pekerja dan masyarakat.** "Transisi yang adil" mencakup pelatihan ulang dan dukungan ekonomi bagi wilayah yang bergantung pada batu bara, minyak, dan gas.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. Hal Lain pada Agenda

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **Pasar karbon.** Aturan untuk memperdagangkan kredit emisi antarnegara dan perusahaan terus disempurnakan. Kualitas dan transparansi adalah kekhawatiran utama.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **Melacak kemajuan dalam adaptasi.** Negara-negara sedang mengerjakan indikator untuk mengukur seberapa baik masyarakat mempersiapkan diri menghadapi dampak iklim.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **Hutan, metana, dan inisiatif khusus sektor lainnya.** Hal ini sering diumumkan di sela-sela acara dan dapat memberikan pengurangan nyata, meskipun biasanya bersifat sukarela.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dianggap sebagai Hasil Nyata

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: Komunike KTT dapat terdengar sangat luas.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: Beberapa penanda membantu memisahkan substansi dari simbolisme:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **Angka dan tanggal, bukan sekadar niat.** Jumlah keuangan yang spesifik, jadwal pengiriman, dan persyaratan pelaporan.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **Akuntabilitas.** Cara yang jelas untuk memeriksa apakah janji ditepati.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **Rencana nasional baru atau yang diperkuat** dari penghasil emisi besar, terutama mereka yang memiliki porsi emisi global terbesar.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **Dana yang mencapai sasaran.** Dana yang dapat diakses oleh negara dan masyarakat yang membutuhkannya.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **Tindak lanjut yang kredibel.** Keputusan yang mencakup proses untuk menindaklanjutinya sebelum COP berikutnya.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, bahasa yang samar, keputusan yang ditunda, dan janji yang tidak didanai adalah tanda-tanda kemajuan yang terbatas.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## Cara Mengikutinya

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - Pembaruan resmi dan ringkasan harian diterbitkan oleh Perubahan Iklim PBB.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - Pelacak independen, seperti yang dijalankan oleh lembaga penelitian, menilai janji nasional dan arus keuangan.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - Organisasi berita terkemuka menawarkan pelaporan dan analisis langsung di lapangan.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: Bandingkan beberapa sumber, dan perlakukan berita utama awal dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: Rincian dalam teks akhir seringkali lebih penting daripada pengumuman awal.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: COP31 tidak mungkin menyelesaikan setiap perselisihan, tetapi dapat memperjelas bagaimana negara-negara berniat untuk menutup kesenjangan antara janji dan tindakan, siapa yang akan membayarnya, dan apakah kerja sama internasional dapat bertahan di tengah politik yang bergeser.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: Perhatikan angka-angka keuangan, kekuatan rencana nasional, dan bahasa tentang bahan bakar fosil.

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: Hal tersebut akan berbicara lebih banyak tentang dampak KTT daripada satu berita utama saja.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **適応資金。** 洪水、熱波、干ばつ、海面上昇に対処するコミュニティを支援するための資金は、排出削減のための資金に比べて遅れている。交渉担当者は、より明確な目標とタイムラインを求めるだろう。

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **損失と被害（ロス＆ダメージ）。** 気候災害から脆弱な国々が回復するのを支援するための基金が、以前のサミットで設立された。現在の問題は、その基金にいくら入っているか、どれだけ迅速に支払われるか、そして誰が受給資格を持つかである。

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **無償資金（グラント）対融資。** 発展途上国は、融資として提供される資金は債務負担を増やす可能性があると繰り返し警告してきた。無償資金と融資の組み合わせは、目立たないが重要な詳細である。

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. 米国の役割

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: 米国は世界最大の歴史的排出国であり、気候資金の主要な供給源である。

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.
segments.tr: 国際的な気候協力に対する米国の姿勢は、パリ協定からの正式な離脱を含め、現政権下で著しく変化した。

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: それはいくつかの実務的な疑問を提起している：

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **資金不足。** 米国の公的資金の拠出が減れば、他の国や民間投資家がその不足分を補えるか？

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **外交的影響力。** 米国の存在感が低下すれば、欧州連合（EU）、中国、その他の大規模な発展途上国など、他の勢力が成果を形成する余地が生まれる可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **ワシントンを超えた行動。** 米国内の州政府、都市、企業は、独自の気候変動対策を継続すると述べている。アンタルヤでこれらのグループがどれほど目立つか、そして彼らのコミットメントが具体的かつ測定可能かどうかに注目してほしい。

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.
segments.tr: 最善の気候政策や、どの国にとっても適切な役割については、理性的な人々の間でも意見が分かれる。

segments.src: What matters for readers is how the changing US position affects the odds of reaching agreements on finance and ambition.
segments.tr: 読者にとって重要なのは、米国の姿勢の変化が、資金や野心に関する合意に達する可能性にどのような影響を与えるかである。

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. 化石燃料とエネルギー転換

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: 近年のサミットで、各国はエネルギーシステムにおける化石燃料からの脱却に原則合意したが、その文言を具体的なステップに変えることは議論を呼んできた。

segments.src: Producer and consumer nations disagree on timing, fairness and the role of natural gas.
segments.tr: 生産国と消費国は、タイミング、公平性、そして天然ガスの役割について意見が対立している。

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: 注目すべき点：

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **ロードマップまたはタイムライン。** 拘束力のある期限がなくても、交渉担当者が移行を計画するためのプロセスに合意するかどうか。

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **再生可能エネルギーと効率化の目標。** 以前のコミットメントでは、2030年までに再生可能エネルギーの容量を3倍にし、効率改善のペースを2倍にすることが求められた。進捗報告書によって、世界が順調に進んでいるかどうかが明らかになるだろう。

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **労働者とコミュニティへの支援。** 「公正な移行」には、石炭、石油、ガスに依存する地域に対する再訓練や経済的支援が含まれる。

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. 議題のその他の項目

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **炭素市場。** 国や企業間で排出枠を取引するためのルールは、引き続き洗練されている。品質と透明性が主な懸念事項である。

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **適応の進捗状況の追跡。** 各国は、コミュニティが気候の影響に対してどれだけうまく準備できているかを測定するための指標に取り組んでいる。

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **森林、メタン、その他のセクター別の取り組み。** これらはしばしばサイドラインで発表され、実質的な削減をもたらす可能性があるが、通常は自主的なものである。

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## 真の成果とみなされるもの

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: サミットのコミュニケ（共同声明）は、大げさに聞こえることがある。

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: 実質と象徴を区別するのに役立ついくつかの指標がある：

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **意図だけでなく、数字と日付。** 具体的な資金の額、提供スケジュール、報告要件。

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **説明責任。** 約束が守られたかどうかを確認するための明確な方法。

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **主要排出国による、新規または強化された国家計画。** 特に世界全体の排出量の大部分を占める国々によるもの。

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **現場に届く資金。** それを必要とする国やコミュニティが利用できる資金。

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **信頼できるフォローアップ。** 次のCOPまでにそれらに基づいて行動するためのプロセスを含む決定。

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: 対照的に、曖昧な言葉、決定の先送り、資金のない公約は、進展が限られている兆候である。

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## フォローする方法

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - 公式の最新情報と毎日の要約は、国連気候変動枠組条約（UNFCCC）によって公開される。

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - 研究機関が運営するものなど、独立したトラッカーが国家の公約や資金の流れを評価する。

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - 信頼できる報道機関が、現地からの報告と分析を提供する。

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: 複数の情報源を比較し、初期のヘッドラインは慎重に扱うこと。

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: 最終的なテキストの詳細は、最初の発表よりも重要なことが多い。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: COP31ですべての紛争が解決する可能性は低いが、各国が約束と行動の間のギャップをどのように埋めるつもりか、誰がその費用を負担するのか、そして変化する政治情勢の中で国際協力が維持できるのかを明確にする可能性がある。

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: 資金の数字、国家計画の強度、そして化石燃料に関する文言に注目してほしい。

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: それらは、どんな単一のヘッドラインよりも、サミットの影響について多くを物語るだろう。

segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、執筆時点で公開されている情報を反映している。

segments.tr: 日付、議題、交渉上の立場は変更される可能性がある。*

de.title: COP31 steht vor der Tür: Was man beim UN-Klimagipfel in Antalya, Türkei, beobachten sollte

segments.src: Delegates from nearly 200 countries are preparing to gather in Antalya, on Turkey's Mediterranean coast, for COP31, the annual United Nations climate conference.
segments.tr: Delegierte aus fast 200 Ländern bereiten sich darauf vor, sich in Antalya an der türkischen Mittelmeerküste zur COP31, der jährlichen UN-Klimakonferenz, zu versammeln.

segments.src: The talks are scheduled for mid-November.
segments.tr: Die Gespräche sind für Mitte November angesetzt.

segments.src: Each summit is billed as a turning point, and most end in compromise instead.
segments.tr: Jeder Gipfel wird als Wendepunkt angekündigt, und die meisten enden stattdessen mit einem Kompromiss.

segments.src: So the useful question is not whether COP31 will "save the climate."
segments.tr: Die nützliche Frage ist also nicht, ob die COP31 das "Klima retten" wird.

segments.src: It is which specific decisions could change what governments, companies and investors actually do.
segments.tr: Es geht darum, welche spezifischen Entscheidungen das tatsächliche Handeln von Regierungen, Unternehmen und Investoren verändern könnten.

segments.src: This guide covers the main issues, the sticking points and the outcomes worth watching.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden behandelt die wichtigsten Themen, die Streitpunkte und die Ergebnisse, die es zu beobachten gilt.

segments.src: Details of the agenda can still shift, so check official UN Climate Change (UNFCCC) updates for the latest schedule.
segments.tr: Einzelheiten der Agenda können sich noch ändern, prüfen Sie daher die offiziellen Updates der UN-Klimarahmenkonvention (UNFCCC) für den neuesten Zeitplan.

segments.src: ## Why COP31 Matters
segments.tr: ## Warum die COP31 wichtig ist

segments.src: The 2015 Paris Agreement set a goal of holding global warming well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels, while pursuing efforts to limit it to 1.5°C.
segments.tr: Das Pariser Abkommen von 2015 setzte das Ziel, die globale Erwärmung deutlich unter 2°C über dem vorindustriellen Niveau zu halten und gleichzeitig Anstrengungen zu unternehmen, sie auf 1,5°C zu begrenzen.

segments.src: Every few years, countries are asked to submit updated national climate plans, known as nationally determined contributions (NDCs).
segments.tr: Alle paar Jahre werden die Länder aufgefordert, aktualisierte nationale Klimapläne einzureichen, die als national festgelegte Beiträge (NDCs) bekannt sind.

segments.src: Each COP is a checkpoint on how those plans, and the money behind them, are progressing.
segments.tr: Jede COP ist ein Kontrollpunkt dafür, wie diese Pläne und die dahinter stehenden Gelder vorankommen.

segments.src: COP31 is also notable for its unusual structure.
segments.tr: Die COP31 ist auch wegen ihrer ungewöhnlichen Struktur bemerkenswert.

segments.src: Turkey is the host country, while Australia was given a leading role in running the negotiations under a compromise reached between the two bidders.
segments.tr: Die Türkei ist das Gastgeberland, während Australien im Rahmen eines zwischen den beiden Bewerbern erzielten Kompromisses eine führende Rolle bei der Leitung der Verhandlungen erhielt.

segments.src: Observers will be watching how that shared arrangement works in practice, and how much weight Pacific island nations, which face some of the most immediate climate risks, carry in the process.
segments.tr: Beobachter werden darauf achten, wie diese geteilte Vereinbarung in der Praxis funktioniert und wie viel Gewicht die pazifischen Inselstaaten, die mit einigen der unmittelbarsten Klimarisiken konfrontiert sind, in den Prozess einbringen.

segments.src: ## 1. Emissions Pledges: Is the Gap Closing?
segments.tr: ## 1. Emissionszusagen: Schließt sich die Lücke?

segments.src: The central tension at every COP is the gap between what countries have promised and what scientists say is needed.
segments.tr: Die zentrale Spannung bei jeder COP ist die Lücke zwischen dem, was die Länder versprochen haben, und dem, was laut Wissenschaft notwendig ist.

segments.src: Recent UN assessments have found that current pledges, even if fully met, would still leave the world well above the 1.5°C goal, and the temperature limit is widely expected to be exceeded at least temporarily.
segments.tr: Jüngste UN-Bewertungen haben ergeben, dass die aktuellen Zusagen, selbst wenn sie vollständig erfüllt würden, die Welt immer noch weit über dem 1,5°C-Ziel belassen würden, und es wird allgemein erwartet, dass das Temperaturlimit zumindest vorübergehend überschritten wird.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Was es zu beobachten gilt:

segments.src: - **Which countries have submitted updated plans, and how ambitious they are.** Some major emitters filed late or with targets that analysts consider modest.
segments.tr: - **Welche Länder aktualisierte Pläne eingereicht haben und wie ehrgeizig diese sind.** Einige große Emittenten reichten ihre Pläne verspätet ein oder mit Zielen, die Analysten als bescheiden betrachten.

segments.src: - **Whether plans cover the whole economy and all greenhouse gases.** Broader targets are easier to track and hold to account.
segments.tr: - **Ob die Pläne die gesamte Wirtschaft und alle Treibhausgase abdecken.** Breitere Ziele sind leichter zu verfolgen und zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen.

segments.src: - **Any process for revisiting weak targets.** The most meaningful outcome would be a mechanism that encourages countries to strengthen their plans before the next round, not just a statement of concern.
segments.tr: - **Jeder Prozess zur Überprüfung schwacher Ziele.** Das sinnvollste Ergebnis wäre ein Mechanismus, der die Länder dazu ermutigt, ihre Pläne vor der nächsten Runde zu stärken, und nicht nur eine bloße Besorgniserklärung.

segments.src: ## 2. Climate Finance: Who Pays, and How Much?
segments.tr: ## 2. Klimafinanzierung: Wer zahlt und wie viel?

segments.src: Money is usually the hardest topic.
segments.tr: Geld ist meist das schwierigste Thema.

segments.src: Developing countries argue that wealthier, historically higher-emitting nations must provide the funds to cut emissions and adapt to the effects of climate change.
segments.tr: Entwicklungsländer argumentieren, dass wohlhabendere Nationen, die historisch gesehen mehr Emissionen verursacht haben, die Mittel bereitstellen müssen, um Emissionen zu senken und sich an die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels anzupassen.

segments.src: Donor countries point to tight budgets and argue that private capital and emerging economies should contribute too.
segments.tr: Geberländer verweisen auf knappe Budgets und argumentieren, dass auch privates Kapital und Schwellenländer einen Beitrag leisten sollten.

segments.src: Key points of friction:
segments.tr: Wichtige Reibungspunkte:

segments.src: - **Delivery of existing promises.** At the 2024 summit in Baku, countries agreed on a new goal of at least $300 billion per year by 2035, within a wider ambition of mobilizing $1.3 trillion annually from all sources. Many developing countries called this inadequate. Expect debate over how the pledges will be tracked and whether they are met on time.
segments.tr: - **Erfüllung bestehender Versprechen.** Auf dem Gipfel 2024 in Baku einigten sich die Länder auf ein neues Ziel von mindestens 300 Milliarden Dollar pro Jahr bis 2035, im Rahmen eines umfassenderen Ziels, jährlich 1,3 Billionen Dollar aus allen Quellen zu mobilisieren. Viele Entwicklungsländer bezeichneten dies als unzureichend. Erwarten Sie eine Debatte darüber, wie die Zusagen nachverfolgt werden und ob sie fristgerecht erfüllt werden.

segments.src: - **Adaptation funding.** Money to help communities cope with floods, heat, drought and sea-level rise has lagged behind funding for emissions cuts. Negotiators will look for clearer targets and timelines.
segments.tr: - **Anpassungsfinanzierung.** Gelder, um Gemeinschaften bei der Bewältigung von Überschwemmungen, Hitze, Dürre und dem Anstieg des Meeresspiegels zu helfen, sind hinter der Finanzierung für Emissionssenkungen zurückgeblieben. Verhandlungsführer werden nach klareren Zielen und Zeitplänen suchen.

segments.src: - **Loss and damage.** A fund to help vulnerable countries recover from climate disasters was created at earlier summits. The questions now are how much it holds, how quickly it pays out and who qualifies.
segments.tr: - **Verluste und Schäden.** Ein Fonds, um gefährdeten Ländern bei der Erholung von Klimakatastrophen zu helfen, wurde auf früheren Gipfeln geschaffen. Die Fragen sind nun, wie viel er enthält, wie schnell er auszahlt und wer anspruchsberechtigt ist.

segments.src: - **Grants versus loans.** Developing countries have repeatedly warned that financing delivered as loans can add to debt burdens. The mix of grants and loans is a quiet but important detail.
segments.tr: - **Zuschüsse versus Darlehen.** Entwicklungsländer haben wiederholt gewarnt, dass Finanzierungen, die als Darlehen gewährt werden, die Schuldenlast erhöhen können. Die Mischung aus Zuschüssen und Darlehen ist ein stilles, aber wichtiges Detail.

segments.src: ## 3. The Role of the United States
segments.tr: ## 3. Die Rolle der Vereinigten Staaten

segments.src: The United States is the world's largest historical emitter and a major source of climate finance.
segments.tr: Die Vereinigten Staaten sind der weltweit größte historische Emittent und eine wichtige Quelle für Klimafinanzierung.

segments.src: Its stance toward international climate cooperation has shifted markedly under the current administration, including a formal withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

segments.src: That raises several practical questions:
segments.tr: Das wirft mehrere praktische Fragen auf:

segments.src: - **Funding gaps.** If the US contributes less public money, can other countries or private investors fill the shortfall?
segments.tr: - **Finanzierungslücken.** Wenn die USA weniger öffentliche Gelder beisteuern, können andere Länder oder private Investoren die Lücke füllen?

segments.src: - **Diplomatic leverage.** A reduced US presence may open room for other powers, including the European Union, China and large developing economies, to shape the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Diplomatischer Einfluss.** Eine reduzierte US-Präsenz könnte anderen Mächten, einschließlich der Europäischen Union, China und großen Schwellenländern, Raum geben, das Ergebnis zu gestalten.

segments.src: - **Action beyond Washington.** State governments, cities and companies in the US have said they will continue their own climate efforts. Look for how visible those groups are in Antalya and whether their commitments are specific and measurable.
segments.tr: - **Handeln jenseits von Washington.** Landesregierungen, Städte und Unternehmen in den USA haben erklärt, dass sie ihre eigenen Klimabemühungen fortsetzen werden. Achten Sie darauf, wie sichtbar diese Gruppen in Antalya sind und ob ihre Verpflichtungen spezifisch und messbar sind.

segments.src: Reasonable people disagree about the best climate policy and about the right role for any single country.

segments.src: ## 4. Fossil Fuels and Energy Transition
segments.tr: ## 4. Fossile Brennstoffe und Energiewende

segments.src: At recent summits, countries have agreed in principle to move away from fossil fuels in energy systems, but turning that language into concrete steps has been contentious.
segments.tr: Auf den jüngsten Gipfeln haben sich die Länder im Prinzip darauf geeinigt, sich in Energiesystemen von fossilen Brennstoffen abzuwenden, aber die Umsetzung dieser Sprache in konkrete Schritte war umstritten.

segments.src: Watch for:
segments.tr: Achten Sie auf:

segments.src: - **A roadmap or timeline.** Whether negotiators agree on a process for planning the transition, even without binding dates.
segments.tr: - **Einen Fahrplan oder Zeitplan.** Ob sich die Verhandlungsführer auf einen Prozess zur Planung der Energiewende einigen, auch ohne verbindliche Daten.

segments.src: - **Targets for renewables and efficiency.** Earlier commitments called for tripling renewable energy capacity and doubling the pace of efficiency improvements by 2030. Progress reports will show whether the world is on track.
segments.tr: - **Ziele für erneuerbare Energien und Effizienz.** Frühere Verpflichtungen forderten eine Verdreifachung der Kapazität erneuerbarer Energien und eine Verdoppelung des Tempos bei Effizienzverbesserungen bis 2030. Fortschrittsberichte werden zeigen, ob die Welt auf dem richtigen Weg ist.

segments.src: - **Support for workers and communities.** A "just transition" includes retraining and economic support for regions that depend on coal, oil and gas.
segments.tr: - **Unterstützung für Arbeitnehmer und Gemeinschaften.** Ein "gerechter Übergang" beinhaltet Umschulung und wirtschaftliche Unterstützung für Regionen, die von Kohle, Öl und Gas abhängig sind.

segments.src: ## 5. Other Items on the Agenda
segments.tr: ## 5. Weitere Punkte auf der Agenda

segments.src: - **Carbon markets.** Rules for trading emission credits between countries and companies continue to be refined. Quality and transparency are the main concerns.
segments.tr: - **Kohlenstoffmärkte.** Regeln für den Handel mit Emissionsgutschriften zwischen Ländern und Unternehmen werden weiter verfeinert. Qualität und Transparenz sind die Hauptanliegen.

segments.src: - **Tracking progress on adaptation.** Countries are working on indicators to measure how well communities are preparing for climate impacts.
segments.tr: - **Verfolgung der Fortschritte bei der Anpassung.** Länder arbeiten an Indikatoren, um zu messen, wie gut sich Gemeinschaften auf die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels vorbereiten.

segments.src: - **Forests, methane and other sector-specific initiatives.** These are often announced on the sidelines and can deliver real reductions, though they are typically voluntary.
segments.tr: - **Wälder, Methan und andere sektorspezifische Initiativen.** Diese werden oft am Rande angekündigt und können echte Reduktionen bewirken, obwohl sie in der Regel freiwillig sind.

segments.src: ## What Would Count as a Real Result
segments.tr: ## Was als echtes Ergebnis zählen würde

segments.src: Summit communiqués can sound sweeping.
segments.tr: Gipfelkommuniqués können weitreichend klingen.

segments.src: A few markers help separate substance from symbolism:
segments.tr: Ein paar Marker helfen dabei, Substanz von Symbolik zu unterscheiden:

segments.src: 1. **Numbers and dates, not just intentions.** Specific finance amounts, delivery schedules and reporting requirements.
segments.tr: 1. **Zahlen und Daten, nicht nur Absichten.** Spezifische Finanzbeträge, Lieferpläne und Berichtsanforderungen.

segments.src: 2. **Accountability.** Clear ways to check whether promises were kept.
segments.tr: 2. **Rechenschaftspflicht.** Klare Wege, um zu überprüfen, ob Versprechen eingehalten wurden.

segments.src: 3. **New or strengthened national plans** from large emitters, especially those with the biggest share of global emissions.
segments.tr: 3. **Neue oder gestärkte nationale Pläne** von großen Emittenten, insbesondere solchen mit dem größten Anteil an globalen Emissionen.

segments.src: 4. **Money that reaches the ground.** Funds that are accessible to the countries and communities that need them.
segments.tr: 4. **Geld, das vor Ort ankommt.** Mittel, die für die Länder und Gemeinschaften zugänglich sind, die sie benötigen.

segments.src: 5. **Credible follow-through.** Decisions that include a process to act on them before the next COP.
segments.tr: 5. **Glaubwürdige Umsetzung.** Entscheidungen, die einen Prozess beinhalten, um vor der nächsten COP danach zu handeln.

segments.src: By contrast, vague language, deferred decisions and unfunded pledges are signs of limited progress.
segments.tr: Im Gegensatz dazu sind vage Sprache, aufgeschobene Entscheidungen und nicht finanzierte Zusagen Anzeichen für begrenzten Fortschritt.

segments.src: ## How to Follow Along
segments.tr: ## Wie man auf dem Laufenden bleibt

segments.src: - Official updates and daily summaries are published by UN Climate Change.
segments.tr: - Offizielle Updates und tägliche Zusammenfassungen werden von UN Climate Change veröffentlicht.

segments.src: - Independent trackers, such as those run by research institutions, assess national pledges and finance flows.
segments.tr: - Unabhängige Tracker, wie sie von Forschungseinrichtungen betrieben werden, bewerten nationale Zusagen und Finanzströme.

segments.src: - Reputable news organizations offer on-the-ground reporting and analysis.
segments.tr: - Seriöse Nachrichtenorganisationen bieten Berichterstattung und Analysen vor Ort.

segments.src: Compare multiple sources, and treat early headlines with caution.
segments.tr: Vergleichen Sie mehrere Quellen und behandeln Sie frühe Schlagzeilen mit Vorsicht.

segments.src: The details in the final text often matter more than the initial announcements.
segments.tr: Die Details im endgültigen Text sind oft wichtiger als die ersten Ankündigungen.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: COP31 is unlikely to resolve every dispute, but it could clarify how countries intend to close the gap between promises and action, who will pay for it and whether international cooperation can hold together amid shifting politics.
segments.tr: Die COP31 wird wahrscheinlich nicht jeden Streit lösen, aber sie könnte klären, wie die Länder die Lücke zwischen Versprechen und Handeln schließen wollen, wer dafür bezahlt und ob die internationale Zusammenarbeit inmitten sich verschiebender Politik zusammenhalten kann.

segments.src: Keep an eye on the finance numbers, the strength of national plans and the language on fossil fuels.
segments.tr: Behalten Sie die Finanzzahlen, die Stärke der nationalen Pläne und die Sprache zu fossilen Brennstoffen im Auge.

segments.src: Those will say more about the summit's impact than any single headline.
segments.tr: Diese werden mehr über die Auswirkungen des Gipfels aussagen als jede einzelne Schlagzeile.
